name: Super Skip Taris & Endar Spire
notes: Adds three reply options to Trask's Endar Spire conversation; each runs one script that sets about 120 globals, recruits six companions, grants XP and credits, then starts the STUNT_06 cutscene chain.
It edits Override files only, so the game's shipped modules are unchanged and no campaign-module or companion rule is needed.
Every player must install it identically. The content digest covers its Override files, so a pair that differs gets the usual mod-mismatch warning.
Live-run 2026-09-29 (docs/research/story-skip-mods.md): the host's skip carried its globals, journal, credits and cutscene chain to a joiner.
